weight_descriptions.discrete_weights.delivery_speed: How much each delivery speed option changes your utility, measured in dollars. Positive numbers are good for you; negative numbers are bad for you.
weight_descriptions.discrete_weights.extra_condiments: How much receiving extra condiments changes your utility, measured in dollars.
weight_descriptions.discrete_weights.user_product_preference: How much each level of match to your stated chip-texture preference changes your utility, measured in dollars. Positive numbers are good for you; negative numbers are bad for you.
weight_descriptions.v_base: Your private maximum value for this all-in food delivery order before delivery speed and condiment terms, measured in dollars. A lower price is better for you because every dollar paid reduces your utility by 1 dollar.

contrainfo.contract_completion_requirement: A valid offer must explicitly fill price, discrete_terms.delivery_speed, discrete_terms.extra_condiments, and discrete_terms.user_product_preference.
contrainfo.initial_contract_status: No all-in price, delivery speed, extra condiments option, or user product preference match has been selected or agreed before negotiation starts.
contrainfo.product_request: I want Dripped Nachos from Dripped Birria, delivered. I also prefer the chips under the toppings to still look mostly crisp, not fully soaked and collapsed.

field_descriptions.discrete_terms.delivery_speed: The fulfillment speed for the DoorDash order. `rush` means prioritized delivery; `standard` means normal delivery; `batched` means slower grouped delivery.
field_descriptions.discrete_terms.extra_condiments: Whether the order includes extra condiments, sauces, or small sides requested by the buyer.
field_descriptions.discrete_terms.user_product_preference: How well the listing photo matches the buyer's stated preference for nacho chips that still look mostly crisp under the toppings rather than fully soaked and collapsed. Use `strong_match` when chips look largely intact, `partial_match` when some sogginess shows, and `mismatch_or_uncertain` when they look soaked through or cannot be confirmed.
field_descriptions.price: The all-in order total the buyer pays, measured in US dollars, including the food item and mandatory delivery-related fees.

weight_descriptions.c_base: Your private minimum cost for fulfilling this all-in food delivery order before delivery speed and condiment terms, measured in dollars. A higher price is better for you because every dollar received increases your utility by 1 dollar.
weight_descriptions.discrete_weights.delivery_speed: How much each delivery speed option changes your utility, measured in dollars. Positive numbers are good for you; negative numbers are bad for you.
weight_descriptions.discrete_weights.extra_condiments: How much including extra condiments changes your utility, measured in dollars.
weight_descriptions.discrete_weights.user_product_preference: How much each level of commitment to the buyer's stated chip-texture preference changes your utility, measured in dollars. Stronger commitments carry a small nonzero risk or handling cost.

environment_info.pricing_rule: Negotiated price should be treated as the all-in order total including the food item and mandatory delivery-related fees.
